title: Membership report export truncates at row limit
summary: Associations with larger membership files cannot get a complete report export once the record count grows past roughly ten thousand rows, because the file stops partway through instead of finishing. Staff are left with partial data and no warning that the export was cut short.

log.why: Truncated export files for large membership lists are a reporting defect with no matching theme in the index.
A donor report cut off past a few thousand rows is the same export row limit truncation, just noticed on a different report.
An export that stops partway once membership passes roughly ten thousand rows is the same row-limit truncation on report exports.
The report export failing partway once membership passes roughly ten thousand rows is the same row-limit truncation already tracked in this theme.
